synopsis: TartanDrive is listed among the machine-mounted off-road datasets considered in Chapter 7, but it was not verified in this research [f5849]. The glossary preserves that qualification, listing TartanDrive and GOOSE without claiming they were verified [f12815]. No validation for off-road collision warning was found for TartanDrive or the other listed datasets; Chapter 7 extends this finding to the listed open-source simulators as well [f12816, f5851]. These are limits of the research findings, not proof that TartanDrive cannot support off-road collision-warning validation [f5849, f5851, f12816].

relations.note: Both state that TartanDrive was listed but not verified in the research.
Both report no off-road collision-warning validation found for the four listed datasets.
Chapter 7 extends the glossary's dataset validation gap to three open-source simulators.
Specifies off-road collision warning as the application for which no validation was found.
